ambient_events: Everything you are leans toward a single point ahead.
The nothing narrows, gently, like a hand closing.
You feel, distantly, the first cold weight of a body that will be yours.
description: The vastness draws in. All the light and wire and vastness of the between rushes toward one point ahead of you — and holds there, trembling, waiting for you to close the last distance. Beyond it you can almost feel a floor of grey tile, a cold that has weight, the specific gravity of being real. One step north and the wave collapses. You will wake somewhere that hurts, and it will be yours.
name: The Collapse
